title: Cancel YouTube Premium in India: Steps, Google Play, Refunds
metaDescription: Cancel YouTube Premium in India on Android, a computer or iPhone, including Google Play and Apple billing. See when benefits end, refunds and the UPI mandate.
h1: How do you cancel YouTube Premium in India, whichever way you paid?
summary: To cancel YouTube Premium in India, open Paid memberships in the YouTube app or go to youtube.com/paid_memberships, then cancel the membership there. If Google Play bills you, cancel in your Google Play subscriptions instead, and if Apple bills you, cancel through your Apple subscriptions. Your benefits continue until the end of the billing period, and you are not charged again unless you re-subscribe.
stepsHeading: How to cancel YouTube Premium in India

steps.name: Check how you are billed
steps.text: Look at recent charges at payments.google.com, or open youtube.com/purchases. Google's help says memberships billed through Google Play or Apple are cancelled in that account. iPhone users billed through Google must cancel from a non-iOS device, such as a computer.

steps.name: Cancel on Android or in the YouTube app
steps.text: Tap your profile picture, then Paid memberships. Tap the membership, tap Continue to cancel, choose your reason and tap Next, then tap Yes, cancel.

steps.name: Cancel on a computer
steps.text: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships, click Manage membership, click Deactivate, click Continue to cancel, choose your reason, click next, then click Yes, cancel.

steps.name: Cancel an Apple or Google Play billing plan
steps.text: For Apple, open Settings, tap Purchases and memberships, tap the membership, tap Manage Apple Subscriptions, tap your membership and tap Cancel. For Google Play, open subscriptions in Google Play, select the YouTube subscription, tap Cancel subscription and follow the instructions.

steps.name: Confirm and revoke the UPI mandate
steps.text: Check youtube.com/paid_memberships for the end date, and look for a cancellation email from an @youtube.com address. Then open the AutoPay section of your UPI app and revoke any mandate linked to YouTube or Google Play.

sections.heading: Monthly, annual and prepaid plans in India
paragraphs: A monthly membership renews automatically. Google's help says you are charged the membership price at the start of each billing cycle until you cancel, so cancelling is the only way to stop it.

Google's annual-plan help page lists India as a country where annual plans are offered. Annual plans are prepaid, non-recurring memberships for individual users. You pay for 12 months upfront, the benefits end after that, and you buy again to keep access. You can buy up to 24 months of prepaid access at a time, and annual plans are not refundable and cannot be paused. To move from monthly to annual, Google says you first cancel the existing membership. The 1-month and 3-month prepaid plans reported for India in 2019 are not in the current help article I read, so check the plan list in the app before paying.

sections.heading: What happens after you cancel, and refunds
paragraphs: Your benefits continue until the end of the billing period you have already paid for, and you are not charged again unless you re-subscribe. The last day of the cycle is shown at youtube.com/paid_memberships. Pausing is not available if Google Play or Apple bills you, so cancel and sign up again later if you want a break.

YouTube's refund page says you are not refunded for the period between cancelling and the end of the membership, and that once a refund is processed you lose access. To cancel immediately with a refund, it says to contact YouTube support. For Google Play purchases, Google's refund policy says you may be able to get a refund within 48 hours of purchase, depending on the details. After that, Google points you to the developer.

sections.heading: Still being charged after cancelling
paragraphs: Start with the cancellation confirmation. YouTube's troubleshooting page says you should see a notification in the app or on the computer, and a cancellation email to your account address. If you see neither, reload the page or restart the app, try an incognito window, or log in on another device and try again.

If charges continue, the likely causes are a different Google subscription, a second Google account with its own membership, or a membership reactivated by mistake. Check the Activity section of your Google payments centre to see what each charge is for, and use Switch account in the profile menu to check any other accounts you own.

sections.heading: Stopping the UPI mandate in your UPI app
paragraphs: Cancelling the membership does not revoke a UPI mandate by itself. In Google Pay, Google's help says to open Autopay, go to the Live tab, tap the mandate and change or revoke it with your UPI PIN. The label may read Autopay or AutoPay, and if the section is missing, update Google Pay. Other UPI apps use different menus, so look for AutoPay or Mandates in each one you have used.

Outlook Money reported in August 2025, citing a Google notice, that Google Play would stop accepting @paytm UPI handles from 31 August 2025 on NPCI's instruction. If a YouTube or Google One payment still points to a Paytm handle, add a different UPI ID to your Play account and move the subscription to it.

sections.heading: Why tracking renewals helps
paragraphs: YouTube Premium can be billed through Google Play, a UPI mandate or Apple, so the same service can appear in three places. One list with each renewal date and monthly cost shows you that YouTube is still active without checking every app. Essara works this way: you add each subscription and mandate yourself, set its renewal date and see the monthly and yearly total. It does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS.

faqs.q: Do I need to cancel an annual YouTube Premium plan in India?
faqs.a: No. Google's help says annual plans are prepaid and non-recurring, so benefits end after the 12 months you paid for. You would only act to stop access early, and Google says to contact YouTube support for that.

faqs.q: How do I check when my YouTube Premium ends?
faqs.a: Visit youtube.com/paid_memberships or youtube.com/purchases. The date shown is the last day of your billing cycle, and it is also when your benefits end.

faqs.q: Can I pause YouTube Premium if Google Play bills me?
faqs.a: No. YouTube's refund page says that with Google Play billing you cannot pause the membership. You can cancel and sign up again at any time instead.

faqs.q: I cancelled YouTube Premium but a charge still came through. Why?
faqs.a: The charge may belong to another Google subscription, the membership may have been reactivated by mistake, or another Google account may hold a membership. Check the Activity section of your Google payments centre to see what the charge is for.

faqs.q: Will YouTube refund the rest of my billing month after I cancel?
faqs.a: Usually not. YouTube's refund page says you are not refunded for the period between cancelling and the end of the membership. If you need an immediate cancellation with a refund, contact YouTube support.
